elements.name: FRESH WATER CHLORINE UNIT ALARM label

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  timestamp                  AS time,
  mak_1_alarm__value         AS fresh_water_mak1_alarm,
  mak_2_alarm__value         AS fresh_water_mak2_alarm,
  chlorine_unit_alarm__value AS fresh_water_chlorine_unit_alarm
FROM public.marpower__250000_fresh_water
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 1

elements.name: FRESH WATER CIRC PUMP running label

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  timestamp                AS time,
  circ_pump_running__value AS fresh_water_circ_pump_running
FROM public.marpower__250000_fresh_water
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 1

elements.name: fresh water circ pump on/off label

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  timestamp              AS time,
  circ_pump_onoff__value AS fresh_water_circ_pump_onoff
FROM public.marpower__250000_fresh_water
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  timestamp                  AS time,

  -- Alarm
  mak_1_alarm__value         AS fresh_water_mak1_alarm,
  mak_2_alarm__value         AS fresh_water_mak2_alarm,
  chlorine_unit_alarm__value AS fresh_water_chlorine_unit_alarm,

  -- Status
  circ_pump_running__value AS fresh_water_circ_pump_running,

  -- Control signals
  circ_pump_onoff__value AS fresh_water_circ_pump_onoff
FROM public.marpower__250000_fresh_water
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
